case_title: HESSAH ALJIRAN VS. 1700 CALIFORNIA STREET ASSOCIATES, LP ET AL

docket_entries.description: SC-109 AUTHORIZATION TO APPEAR. MARIA VILLEGAS, PROPERTY MANAGER FILED BY DEFENDANT 1700 CALIFORNIA STREET ASSOCIATES, LP
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-26-2024 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ALJIRAN, HESSAH RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT 1700 CALIFORNIA STREET ASSOCIATES, LP MOSSER COMPANIES $1,990.00 PRINCIPAL, $390.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,380.00, PLAINTIFF PROVED THAT BEETLES IN HER APARTMENT WERE DISTRESSING. HOWEVER, SHE FAILED TO PROVE HARASSMENT OR THAT DEFENDANTS' ACTION RESULTED IN HER NEEDING TO REPLACE HER BEDFRAME, MATTRESS, AND BEDDING. NOR DID SHE FOLLOW THE LAW CONCERNING WITHHOLDING RENT FOR HABITABILITY ISSUES AND THUS CANNOT RECOVER HER SECURITY DEPOSIT WHICH WAS USED TO PAY PAST RENT DUE. WHILE DEFENDANTS INITIALLY PROMPTLY RESPONDED TO THE PEST ISSUE, THE DELAY IN SEALING THE KITCHEN (SEE ATTACHMENT) STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS, SEE JUDGMENT ATTACHED PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
DECLARATION OF NEW ADDRESS: 790 32ND AVENUE, SF, CA 94121 FILED BY PLAINTIFF ALJIRAN, HESSAH
ORDER RE: CONTINUANCE PER PLAINTIFF'S REQUEST. MATTER CONTINUED TO 11/26/24 AT 10:00 A.M.
DISMISSAL WITH PREJUDICE OF CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FILED BY PLAINTIFF ALJIRAN, HESSAH AS TO DEFENDANT GO-MOSSER

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-04-2024 - CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF PLAINTIFF TO NOV-26-2024 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF HESSAH ALJIRAN IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT 1700 CALIFORNIA STREET ASSOCIATES, REPRESENTED BY MARIA VILLEGAS, PROPERTY MANGER IS PRESENT. MARIA VILLEGAS REPRESENTS TO COURT THAT SHE IS ALSO A REPRESENTATIVE FOR DEFENDANT MOSSER COMPANIES. DEFENDAT GO-MOSSER IS NOT PRESENT. JUDGE PRO TEM WILLIAM LYNN MAKES A DISCLOSURE TO PARTIES PRESENT. PLAINTIFF DOES NOT ACCEPT JUDGE PRO TEM WILLIM LYNN'S DISCLOSURE AND DOES NOT STIPULATE TO THE JUDGE PRO TEM. THE MATTER IS CONTINUED TO NOVEMBER 26, 2024 AT 10:00 A.M. COURT NOTES THAT DEFENDANT GO-MOSSER IS NOT A VALID BUSINESS ENTITY. PLAINTIFF NEEDS TO AMEND HER CLAIM CORRECTLY NAMING THE GO-MOSSER ENTITY AND PROVIDE VALID PROOF OF SERVICE TO THE COURT OF THE AMENDED CLAIM OR THE GO-MOSSER ENTITY NEEDS TO BE DISMISSED BY PLAINTIFF. CASE FILE RETAINED IN THE COURTROOM. JUDGE PRO TEM: WILLIAM LYNN; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED
